title: Ridgeline Consumer Credit Courtesy Late-Fee Waiver Conditions
content:
**Desk rule.** A correctly charged late fee on a Ridgeline Consumer Credit account may be waived in full as a courtesy at the cardholder's request. Returned payment fees and phone payment fees are never waived as a courtesy. Every one of the following conditions must hold, each read from the account's own records:

1. **Active account.** The account status must be active at the time of the request.
2. **Months on book.** The account must have been open for at least the tier's months-open figure in full calendar months since the account was opened. Months on book are counted in whole calendar months from the opening date: the account reaches N months on the same day of the month N months later, or on the last day of that month when that day does not exist. An account that has reached the figure on the day of the request qualifies.
3. **Request window.** The waiver must be requested no more than the tier's request window in calendar days after the late fee was posted. Days are counted as calendar days from the late fee's posting date as day 0 to the date of the request, and a request on the last day of the window still qualifies.
4. **Waivers already used.** The courtesy waivers on the account dated in the rolling 12 calendar months ending on the date of the request must number fewer than the tier's waivers-per-12-months allowance.
5. **Only late fee in 12 months.** The late fees on the account dated in the rolling 12 calendar months ending on the date of the request — counting the fee being waived, and leaving out any late fee reversed with the posting error reason — must number exactly one.
6. **Not already settled.** A late fee that already has a reversal line or a waiver line referencing it cannot be waived.

**Correction first.** When the fee is owed a correction as a fee that should not have been charged, the correction applies instead and no courtesy waiver is used.

## Boundary dates (hypothetical)

| Condition | Anchor | Qualifies | Does not qualify |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6 months on book | opened 31 August 2025 | request on 28 February 2026 | request on 27 February 2026 |
| 12 months on book | opened 10 March 2025 | request on 10 March 2026 | request on 9 March 2026 |
| 60-day request window | late fee posted 1 March | request on 30 April (day 60) | request on 1 May (day 61) |

## Count cases (hypothetical, on a tier allowing one waiver in 12 months)

| Waivers in the 12 months | Late fees in the 12 months, this fee included | Condition 4 and 5 result |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 1 | both met |
| 0 | 2 | not met (more than one late fee) |
| 0 | 2, the other one reversed for posting error | both met (the reversed fee is left out) |
| 1 | 1 | not met (allowance used) |
